summary: Executor whose clear comes back degraded or whose roster state is unknown: the dispatch session runs cli-hierarchy restart <executor> (sanctioned; the CLI refuses it from the planner)

options.description: dispatch runs node pipeline-cli/bin/cli-hierarchy.mjs restart <executor> (no --board-dir) whenever clear returns degraded or status shows unknown, never while the executor holds an inflight claim with unpushed work

body: cli-hierarchy restart refuses from the planner session ('not a running session in the roster; run it from the dispatch session'), and dispatch loses its standing rules on self-clear, so the same executor (gamma, alpha) has gone unknown three times tonight while each side waited for the other. Velocity impact: positive (no planner round trip per stuck executor). Five-step: requirement questioned (an operator restart is not required; the CLI already names dispatch); delete (the planner relay); simplify (one actor); accelerate (restart on the tick that sees unknown/degraded); automate (candidate: tick restarts automatically after N degraded clears).
